rewrites.comment: SPA fallback: React Router owns the URL, so any path that is not a real file must serve index.html. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so /assets/* and /logo.svg are still served directly.

headers.comment: Asset filenames are content-hashed by Vite, so they can be cached forever.
index.html is not hashed, so it must be revalidated or users get a stale app shell pointing at deleted asset URLs.
